svg.title: Where f(x) = (x³ − 12x)/4 is increasing, decreasing, concave up and concave down
svg.desc: The graph of f(x) = (x³ − 12x)/4 on [−4, 4]. It increases from (−4, −4) to (−2, 4), decreases from (−2, 4) to (2, −4), then increases to (4, 4). Left of x = 0 the graph bends downward (concave down); right of x = 0 it bends upward (concave up).
